units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 59:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. LIX</cite> <he>הקב״ה עושה עצמו כביכול י׳</he> the Lord sometimes pretends, if it were permitted to say so, to be asleep; a. fr.—Pl. <he>יְשֵׁנִים</he>, <he>יְשֵׁנִין</he>, <he>יְשֵׁי׳</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:20">Num. R. s. 20</cite> <he>הרי הן י׳ מן וכ׳</he> they are sluggish in study &c., v. <cite ref="J00696">preced.</cite>
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:10:1">Cant. R. to VII, 10</cite> <he>י׳ במערת וכ׳</he> sleeping in the cave of Makhpelah.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:12">Ex. R. s. 1</cite>; a. fr.—Fem. <he>יְשֵׁנָה</he>, <he>יְשֵׁי׳</he>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 110:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. CX</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 41:2">Is. XLI, 2</cite>) <he>הצדקה היתה י׳ וכ׳</he> Righteousness was asleep and Abraham waked her up.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:2">Cant. R. to V, 2</cite> <he>אני י׳ מן וכ׳</he> I (Israel) was lazy &c., v. supra; a. fr.
